entries.zh: 仪容举止；端庄得体（人的容止、仪态）
齐整俊秀；标致（「伶俐」之「伶」）
entries.en: Neat, spruce, handsome; well turned out

entries.zh: 伶俐；标致齐整、伶俐可人
冠冕；礼冠（亦指帽冠整饰成形）
entries.en: Crown and ceremonial cap; a formal hat (one blocked/dressed into shape)
entries.notes: L 栏「compostura... el sombrero cerrado」文意含混，H 栏「冠冕」取礼服冠帽义，具体所指系推断。

entries.zh: 买；采买（字形与对音不合，姑从西语「comprar」）
entries.notes: H 栏作「劃」，与 M「hǎy」、R「choĕy」均不合，疑字形或对音有讹，仅依 L 栏定「买」义。

entries.en: To purchase, to lay in; to acquire (goods or property)

entries.zh: 零买小物；挑拣着买零星东西
entries.en: To buy small items, odds and ends
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑]（捘/揀），M「go chiaŭ」与 R「cheû」不能互证，字形与词义均未定，仅依 L 栏释义。
L 栏空白，依 H 栏「貿」及 R「māu」定为贸易义。

entries.zh: 籴；买进粮食（引申为成批购入）
entries.en: To buy grain; to buy in bulk
entries.notes: L 栏「avult.」当为「a bulto」（成批）之省，H 栏「糴」本指买粮。

entries.en: To get in / provide what is needed; to buy provisions
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑]（僃辨/備辦），按闽南语 pān 与「comprar lo necesario」定为「備辦」。

entries.en: To buy in addition, to eke out one's stock
entries.notes: L 栏「paraq alance」为「para que alcance」之缩写，即买来使够用。

entries.zh: 承接合伙人的货物份额；盘下股货
entries.en: To buy a partner's share of the stock/goods
entries.notes: L 栏末句「y aparta del tras -」残缺，H 栏「坐貨」为生僻商语，后半义不能定读。

entries.zh: 主顾；老主顾（按约定认购一份者）
entries.en: Patron, regular customer (one who takes a share by standing arrangement)
entries.notes: H 栏「主顧」为老主顾，其与 L 栏「按约定购一份」的对应关系系推断。

entries.zh: 主客；固定往来的买卖双方（老主顾关系）
entries.en: Host and guest; a standing buyer-seller relationship
entries.notes: L 栏「...in, yacu bir siempre balle -」严重残缺，无法确证「主客」与西语义的对应。

entries.en: To buy jointly, to club together to buy
